decision.rule: PRE-REGISTERED before the run; each arm is judged in its DOCUMENTED ROLE, not the charter's original bake-off-both framing. CPPN (generator): reject if validity < the dossier bar 0.85 (the B2 bake-off's own bar) — validity is the first gate and nothing offsets it; reject if distinct rate <= 0.68 (the committed refused random arm's measured floor); prototype if it matches the adopted constrained layer's committed row (DR 0042) on BOTH validity and readability; watch otherwise. Adopt is deliberately unreachable at stage 0 — the charter's own verbs are reject/watch/prototype, and adoption is a decision-record act at documented scale, not a prototype verdict. Shape grammar (post-generator stabilizer, judged at the incumbent wfc_grid._finish's own job): reject if it does not raise validity over the raw collapse beyond the measured noise; reject if distinct retention falls below 0.68 (over-constraining novelty, the dossier's named risk); prototype only if it beats the incumbent _finish on validity beyond the two-seed noise floor without worse distinct retention; watch on a tie within noise; reject if it loses to the incumbent beyond noise — the DR 0031 hybrid-refutation logic: a challenger that adds nothing over the shipped incumbent is refused. Instrument gate: at the committed protocol (batch 100, seed 1030) the harness must reproduce the committed wfc row of generation_bakeoff16_stage0.json exactly; a mismatch raises instead of writing an artifact.
